human.problem: Sodom, Chorazin, Bethsaida, Tyre, Sidon and later Capernaum (card 18) appear with no word on what or where they are. The only hints are 'towns' and 'cities'. The new-people rule names only people ('the first time someone shows up').
human.question: Should the new-people rule also cover places, so that Papa Dorin briefly says what a place is the first time it appears? Or are place names left to the dictionary pop-up?

human.problem: Card 19 is a True or False card with False as the right answer. It only tells the baker that Capernaum will not be lifted up. What Jesus actually says, that Capernaum will be brought down to Hades (Luke 10:15), never appears on any card.
human.question: When a False answer leaves out what the text actually says, must a later story card tell it? Or is it enough for the reveal screen and answer explanation to carry it?
